lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: He had it folded in his jacket. Four hundred and six names and a second column that is not wages at all. It's a headcount for something that was never going to be paid.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It's a purchase order. The second column is what the crews cost as a line item, filed against an asset that hasn't been built yet.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Take the list. I've got a copy, and a copy is worth more than an original when somebody's coming for the original.

lines.speaker: camp_clerk
lines.text: Now. I can file it with the labour board this afternoon, with every name on it, and be looking for work by Monday. Or I can put it back in his jacket and neither of us mentions it again.

choices.text: File it. Put every name in the record.
Put it back. You have a job and they have wages.
That is your call to make.
